question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.

We sincerely thanked them for their ________________ (benevolence) and generosity.
solution:
Here is the solution for the given question in the requested HTML format:

```html
The correct answer is '**kindness**'.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**benevolence**" refers to kindness and generosity.
 
• Kindness is the most appropriate synonym for benevolence in this context.
 
• The other options: "**intention**," "**liberty**," and "**suspicion**" do not fit the meaning of benevolence.

​Therefore, the correct answer is '**Option 4**'.

**Complete Sentence:** *We sincerely thanked them for their kindness__ and generosity.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Intention (इरादा)**: refers to a purpose or aim.
 
• **Liberty (स्वतंत्रता)**: refers to freedom or independence.
 
• **Suspicion (संदेह)**: refers to doubt or mistrust.

```
